% Focused visual regression for pgflibraryplotmarks halfcircle declarations.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{plotmarks}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=11cm,
    height=4.5cm,
    xmin=0,
    xmax=5,
    ymin=-1,
    ymax=1,
    axis lines=middle,
    grid=major,
    xtick={1,2,3,4},
    ytick={-0.5,0,0.5}
  ]
    \addplot[only marks, blue, mark=halfcircle, mark size=10pt]
      coordinates {(1,0)};
    \addplot[only marks, red, mark=halfcircle, mark color=orange, mark size=10pt]
      coordinates {(2,0)};
    \addplot[only marks, purple, mark=halfcircle*, mark color=green,
      mark options={rotate=90}, mark size=10pt]
      coordinates {(3,0)};
    \addplot[only marks, cyan, mark=halfcircle, mark color=none, mark size=10pt]
      coordinates {(4,0)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
